capabilities: Insert items into a note via pairwise comparison
Prompt the user to choose between the new item and existing items
Rank new items against existing note lines as the source list
Run the insertion from the command palette on desktop and mobile
disambiguation: It does not sort an existing list; it focuses on inserting new items, using an existing list only as the ranking source.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to build a ranked list by comparing new items against existing ones.
summary: Pairwise ranking tool that inserts new line items into a note by asking which of two items is higher until the position is found.
